title: 第014章 接风宴大厅第015章 至尊包厢
content_zh:
;;
拿着银行卡放进了百宝袋之内。
秦雨水刚要带秦延军出去，又想到了云梦蝶对自己的小主有意思，于是说道：“云小姐可以一起去吗？还要给小主买衣服，我是个大男人，不是太懂。”
秦雨水的意思云梦蝶当然清楚，感激的看了秦雨水一眼：“秦经理，当然可以，乐于效劳！”
于是，三人就一起走出了总裁办公室。
吴茉莉看着三人离开，对刘紫嫣说道：“希望他们能修成正果，也让我们这些师姐师兄有个交代！”
刘紫嫣说道：“总裁，我看把握挺大的，你的小师弟虽然没有说什么，但是看的出来，他也没有反对，这说明她也有意思！”
“哦！真的吗？那太好了，今天晚上的接风宴，我们想办法撮合一下。对了，我的三师妹，如果来的话，可能中午就会到，麻烦刘秘书长多留意一下！”
“好的，总裁，我会留意的。”
秦雨水、秦延军和云梦蝶来到商场，云梦蝶十分用心地挑选着衣服，她不时拿起衣服在秦延军身前比划，眼中满是期待。秦延军虽然有些腼腆，但也配合着她的挑选。
与此同时，公司里，吴茉莉刚处理完一些事务，刘紫嫣匆匆跑来：“总裁，您三师妹到了。”吴茉莉赶忙起身去迎接。三师妹名叫罗青青，虽然50几岁，但看起来也就40来岁的样子，长相甜美，性格活泼。罗青青一见到吴茉莉就扑了上去：“师姐，可想死我啦。”
吴茉莉笑着摸了摸她的头，把接风宴要撮合秦延军和云梦蝶的事说了。罗青青眼睛一亮：“师姐，这事儿包在我身上，我最会搞这些啦。”
五师弟叶峰也凑上前来说道：“大师姐，三师姐，既然小师弟有这个缘分，我这个做五师兄的也得参与其中，希望他们能够有情人终成眷属！”
另一边，秦雨水看着两人相处融洽，暗暗点头。买完衣服后，他们准备回公司，一场充满惊喜的接风宴正等着他们。
晚上。
飞翔酒店。
一楼大厅。
此时，正是用餐高峰期，人很多，有的是迎接客人的，也有纨绔在这里想要找到艳遇，有的想要寻找白马王子，也有的想要勾搭有钱的大款。
这时，云梦蝶挽着秦延军的手臂走了进来，秦雨水紧跟着。
三人刚走进大厅，一名公子哥笑盈盈的走了过来，手中还拿着一束玫瑰花，后面跟着四名保镖。

“梦蝶，晚上好，就知道你要来用晚餐，我在这里已经等了你很久了。可以给我一个面子，一起用餐吗？”公子哥来到面前，微笑着说道。
云梦蝶一脸厌恶的说道：“刘大公子，不要又来缠着我，我已经有男朋友了，不要再来骚扰我。请叫我全名，或者云总裁！谢谢！”
秦延军虽然买了衣服，但是也没有换，还是穿着那一身乞丐服。这在世家豪门的眼里，根本就是不入眼。
刘大公子名叫刘兴龙，是当代家主刘永强的大公子，还有两个弟弟，老二刘兴虎，老三刘兴豹。三兄弟当中，除了老三刘兴豹为人老实一些，两个兄长一个比一个纨绔，成天惹是生非。
刘兴龙藐视的看着秦延军说道：“哪来的垃圾？竟敢沾染我看上的女人，赶紧给我滚出去，否则就让你躺着出去。”
云梦蝶脚一跨挡在秦延军前面说道：“刘兴龙，你好歹也是世家子弟，这里这么多人，你不觉得丢人吗？”
刘兴龙刚要说话，这时候又从外面走进来一群人。
大家一看，竟然是王家家主王猛带着家人，后面跟随着自己的老婆刘秀珍，儿子王海成，跟着几名保镖。
刚刚走进来的王猛一看是刘兴龙，慢慢的走上前。
刘兴龙赶紧打招呼：“王叔叔，你也来用餐吗？刚好我也订了包厢，不如我们一起用餐。”

He took the bank card and put it into the treasure bag.
Just as Qin Yuyu was about to take Qin Yanjun out, he thought that Yun Mengdie was interested in his little master, so he said, "Miss Yun, can we go together? We also need to buy clothes for the little master. I am a grown man and I don't know much about it."
Of course Yun Mengdie knew what Qin Yuyu meant, and glanced at Qin Yuyu gratefully: "Of course, Manager Qin, I'm happy to help!"
So, the three of them walked out of the president's office together.
Wu Moli watched the three people leave and said to Liu Ziyan: "I hope they can achieve positive results and let us senior sisters and brothers have an explanation!"
Liu Ziyan said: "President, I think I'm quite sure. Although your junior brother didn't say anything, it can be seen that he didn't object, which means she is also interested!"
"Oh! Really? That's great. Let's find a way to coordinate the reception banquet tonight. By the way, if my third junior sister comes, she may arrive at noon. Secretary-General Liu, please pay more attention!"
"Okay, President, I'll keep an eye on it."
Qin Yuyu, Qin Yanjun and Yun Mengdie came to the mall. Yun Mengdie carefully selected clothes. She picked up the clothes from time to time and gestured in front of Qin Yanjun, her eyes full of anticipation. Although Qin Yanjun was a little shy, he also cooperated with her choice.
At the same time, in the company, Wu Moli had just finished handling some matters, and Liu Ziyan hurried over: "President, your third junior sister is here." Wu Moli hurriedly got up to greet her. The third junior sister is named Luo Qingqing. Although she is in her 50s, she looks like she is in her 40s. She has a sweet appearance and a lively personality. As soon as Luo Qingqing saw Wu Moli, she rushed towards her: "Senior sister, you miss me so much."
Wu Moli smiled and touched her head, and told Jie Feng Yan that she wanted to bring Qin Yanjun and Yun Mengdie together. Luo Qingqing's eyes lit up: "Senior sister, I'll take care of this. I'm the best at doing this."
The fifth junior brother Ye Feng also came forward and said: "Senior sister, third senior sister, since the younger junior brother has this fate, I, the fifth senior brother, must also participate in it. I hope they can find lovers and get married eventually!"
On the other side, Qin Yuyu watched the two getting along well and nodded secretly. After buying clothes, they were ready to go back to the company, where a surprise reception party was waiting for them.
night.
Fly Hotel.
The lobby on the first floor.
At this time, it is the peak dining period, and there are many people. Some are greeting guests, some are here looking for a romantic encounter, some are looking for Prince Charming, and some are looking to hook up with rich men.
At this time, Yun Mengdie walked in holding Qin Yanjun's arm, followed closely by Qin Yuyu.
As soon as the three of them entered the hall, a young man walked over with a smile on his face, holding a bouquet of roses in his hand, followed by four bodyguards.
"Mengdie, good evening. I knew you were coming for dinner. I have been waiting for you here for a long time. Can you give me a favor and have dinner together?" Young Master came to the front and said with a smile.
Yun Mengdie said with a look of disgust: "Master Liu, don't pester me again. I already have a boyfriend. Don't harass me again. Please call me by my full name, or President Yun! Thank you!"
Although Qin Yanjun bought clothes, he did not change them. He was still wearing the beggar's clothes. In the eyes of wealthy families, this is simply unacceptable.
The eldest son Liu is named Liu Xinglong. He is the eldest son of the contemporary head of the family, Liu Yongqiang. He also has two younger brothers, the second brother Liu Xinghu and the third brother Liu Xingbao. Among the three brothers, except for Liu Xingbao, the third brother, who is more honest, the two brothers are more dandy than the other, causing trouble all the time.
Liu Xinglong looked at Qin Yanjun with contempt and said: "Where did this garbage come from? How dare you touch the woman I like, get out of here, otherwise I will let you go out lying down."
Yunmeng Butterfly stepped in front of Qin Yanjun and said: "Liu Xinglong, you are also a descendant of a noble family. There are so many people here, don't you feel embarrassed?"Just as Liu Xinglong was about to speak, another group of people walked in from outside.
When everyone saw it, it turned out to be Wang Meng, the head of the Wang family, with his family, followed by his wife Liu Xiuzhen, son Wang Haicheng, and several bodyguards.
Wang Meng, who had just walked in, saw that it was Liu Xinglong and slowly walked forward.
Liu Xinglong quickly said hello: "Uncle Wang, are you coming to dine too? I happen to have booked a private room, so why don't we dine together."
